pass_1.finding: The named kit manual prints E7601A as 65 bases with the additional C, including 5′ phosphate, internal dU and terminal phosphorothioate; it lists index-primer families but cannot identify which pair was used for these libraries. pass_2.locations: Official NEB E7600 Dual Index Primers Set 1 manual PDF, Adaptor Overview p.3 lines 55–76 and revision history p.14 lines 443–461; primer Appendix pp.11–12 lines 283–414
pass_2.finding: Current manual prints E7601A as 65 nt with ACACTCTTTCCCTACACGACG, U-containing hairpin opened by USER and i5/i7 primer families. Revision history says NEB corrected adapter sequence in Nov 2017; this later manual cannot prove which physical lot/sequence Tsai used earlier in 2017.

pass_2.locations: Original PMC5924695 JATS Online Methods lines 103–127; Original Springer MOESM84 PDF text lines 60–90, 275–305; Original PMC Cloud supplement-3 DOCX text lines 30–36, 145–172; Official NEB E7600 Dual Index Primers Set 1 manual PDF, Adaptor Overview p.3 lines 55–76 and revision history p.14 lines 443–461; primer Appendix pp.11–12 lines 283–414

missing_claims.claim: The sequence of the post-cleavage adapter is undisclosed
missing_claims.evidence: Supplementary Protocol line 292 prints E7601A with a one-C discrepancy; the named NEB E7600 manual prints the 65-base adapter. Both values and the model choice are displayed on the page.

missing_claims.claim: The selected i5 and i7 index pair can be reconstructed
missing_claims.evidence: The protocol names a dual-index primer kit but no particular pair; NEB prints a family. Historic kit version and experiment metadata have not been fully audited.

conclusion: Two located independent passes on the available original, protocol and individually checked supplements. NEB revision history shows its adapter sequence was corrected in November 2017; the physical lot used for the earlier study and chosen i5/i7 pair remain unverified, so missing claims stay blocked.
